items.title: Bill Matthews Interview, 1959-03-10
items.q: And he was playing there with Fess. Old Fess had charge of the band.

ctx.x: How was Roy Palmer? What style did he have?

Palmer? Uh huh. Palmer was in between them. Roy Palmer. He was a good musician. Baratone and trombone. He played at the villa. One place, one spot all the time. Him and the old dude you see the old piano around you, play around you, all that you see. And he was playing there with Fess. Old Fess had charge of the band. I don't know if he told you about it. He mentioned it once.
Did you ever play with Fess at all? That's right. Have you played with Fess?
